title: Start Investing Early Grows Wealth

scenes.text: Investing at age 25 can double your retirement nest egg
Each extra year of investing adds roughly seven percent growth thanks to compounding
scenes.label: SEVEN PERCENT GROWTH

scenes.text: Starting at 25 versus 35 often means twice the final balance
scenes.label: TWICE THE NEST EGG

scenes.text: Even contributing five thousand dollars a year compounds dramatically over a 40‑year horizon
scenes.label: FIVE THOUSAND YEARLY

scenes.text: Follow if you're done staying broke.

description: The sooner you start, the more your money works for you. Simple numbers show massive long‑term benefits.
